senses.zh_definition: Hoo：一种姓氏的罗马字拼写，也见于马来西亚及新加坡；仅凭该拼写无法确定对应汉字、读音或具体人物。
senses.en_definition: A surname spelling found, among other places, in Malaysia and Singapore; its precise origin and pronunciation depend on the bearer.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan Rumi bagi suatu nama keluarga yang turut digunakan di Malaysia dan Singapura; asal serta sebutannya bergantung pada pemilik nama.
senses.nuances: 这是有来源支持的可能解释，并不能证明原包中的 hoo 一定是姓氏。不可据此固定译作某个汉字姓，也不可自动认定为感叹词。status 按所要求的结构填写，不构成官方词条认证。以下称谓搭配为示例，频率未核实；马来文释义为编写释义。[Ancestry 引《Dictionary of American Family Names》：Hoo](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/hoo)

etymology.historical_story: A family-name dictionary records Hoo as a romanized Chinese surname with more than one possible source, including forms associated with Hu and He. It also notes its presence in Malaysia and Singapore. The spelling therefore preserves a family naming tradition, but cannot by itself reveal a particular bearer's Chinese characters or pronunciation. [Ancestry's dictionary extract](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/hoo)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式记录沿用本人证件拼写。不要擅自替换为 Ho、Hu、Khoo 或某个汉字姓；这些形式不能仅凭外观相似就认定为同一姓名。
